impact: Broad AI and growth selling hits MU, DRAM, SNXX, NBIS, PLTR and GOOGL/MSFT together; Oracle's 52-week low signals stress in AI infrastructure financing that matters for NBIS. The holiday-thin Friday session could amplify moves.
summary: US stocks fell sharply on Wednesday, the last full session before Thanksgiving, after hotter-than-expected core PCE and the new tariff proposal. The Nasdaq Composite was down between 1.9% and about 4% at different points, and the Nasdaq 100 briefly fell 20% below its record closing high; the Nasdaq and S&P 500 were on pace for their worst November since 2008. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell over 6%, Nvidia was down about 7% to 8.4%, Intel 9.7%, AMD 8.9%, Dell 7.6% and Oracle 8.2% to a new 52-week low. Figures are intraday; markets are shut Thursday and close early Friday.
title: Nasdaq slides up to 4% on hot PCE, tariffs and chip rout; Nasdaq 100 hits bear market intraday
